--- Table 1: adventureworks.person.addresstype ---
Domain: Person
Description: Types of addresses stored in the Address table.
Fields:
  - rowguid (uuid): System-generated globally unique identifier used for database replication and data synchronization purposes
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when the address type definition was last updated or modified
  - name (character varying(50)): Descriptive label of the address type such as Home, Work, Billing, or Shipping
  - addresstypeid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Unique numeric identifier serving as the primary key for each address type record

--- Table 2: adventureworks.person.countryregion ---
Domain: Location
Description: Lookup table containing the ISO standard codes for countries and regions.
Fields:
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): The date and time when the country or region record was last modified, used for data synchronization and audit tracking
  - name (character varying(50)): The official full name of the country or region as defined by the ISO standard
  - countryregioncode (character varying(3)) [PK]: The unique 3-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code that identifies the country or region
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 3: adventureworks.production.culture ---
Domain: Localization
Description: Lookup table containing the languages in which some AdventureWorks data is stored.
Fields:
  - name (character varying(50)): The display name of the language or culture (e.g., English, Spanish, French)
  - cultureid (character(6)) [PK]: The standardized culture identifier code (e.g., en-US, es-MX) used to format dates, numbers, and currency for specific regions
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): The timestamp recording when this language or culture record was last modified in the system
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 4: adventureworks.production.billofmaterials ---
Domain: Manufacturing
Description: Items required to make bicycles and bicycle subassemblies. It identifies the heirarchical relationship between a parent product and its components.
Fields:
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp of the most recent modification to this bill of materials record, indicating when the data was last updated
  - perassemblyqty (numeric(8,2)): Quantity of the component required per one unit of the parent product assembly
  - startdate (timestamp without time zone): Effective date when this bill of materials configuration becomes valid and can be used in production
  - unitmeasurecode (character(3)) [FK]: Three-character code specifying the unit of measure for the component quantity (e.g., EA for each, LB for pounds)
  - bomlevel (smallint(16,0)): Numeric level in the product hierarchy indicating the nesting depth (0 for top-level assemblies, increasing for sub-components)
  - productassemblyid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Reference to the parent product that will be assembled from components (the finished or intermediate product being manufactured)
  - enddate (timestamp without time zone): Expiration date when this bill of materials configuration is no longer valid; null indicates it is currently active
  - componentid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Reference to the child part or component that goes into making the parent product assembly
  - billofmaterialsid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Unique identifier for each bill of materials record, serving as the primary key for this table
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 5: adventureworks.production.illustration ---
Domain: Product
Description: Bicycle assembly diagrams.
Fields:
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp indicating when the bicycle assembly diagram was last modified or updated
  - illustrationid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Unique identifier for each bicycle assembly diagram illustration record
  - diagram (xml): XML-formatted assembly diagram containing visual instructions for bicycle component assembly

--- Table 6: adventureworks.purchasing.vendor ---
Domain: Vendor
Description: Companies from whom Adventure Works Cycles purchases parts or other goods.
Fields:
  - purchasingwebserviceurl (character varying(1024)): Web service endpoint URL used for electronic data interchange and automated purchasing transactions with the vendor
  - name (character varying(50)): Official business name of the vendor or supplier company
  - activeflag (boolean): Indicator of whether the vendor is currently operational and conducting business
  - accountnumber (character varying(15)): Internal accounting code assigned to track and process financial transactions with the vendor
  - businessentityid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Unique identifier referencing the underlying business entity record for data consistency across the enterprise
  - creditrating (smallint(16,0)): Numerical assessment of the vendor's creditworthiness and financial reliability, typically on a scale where lower values indicate better credit standing
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp recording the most recent update to the vendor's master record for audit and synchronization purposes
  - preferredvendorstatus (boolean): Flag designating whether the vendor is approved and prioritized as a preferred supplier for purchasing decisions
